candidate.name: treasury_auction_unwind_tlt_v1

formula.qualify: S_j=1 only for an original nominal 30-year Treasury issue or reopening with both required original documents available by the frozen cutoff
formula.tenor_rule: original tenor, not exact remaining maturity, determines a reopening
formula.offering_amount_use: provenance and mechanism attribution only; never selection or sizing

candidate.hypothesis: A small post-auction long-duration exposure may capture selective normalization using issuance-event information absent from the incumbent signals; it is not a universal hedge.
candidate.literature_boundary: The cited literature motivates the mechanism only and is not local performance or implementation evidence.

event_contract.required_available_at: Both original documents must have a provable available_at at or before decision_cutoff.
event_contract.entry: next regular-session TLT open after the qualifying event
event_contract.exit: fifth regular-session open after entry, producing five open-to-open holding intervals
event_contract.same_date_events: Multiple qualifying securities on one date form one event exposure.
event_contract.overlap: Overlapping signals do not pyramid or extend the first event's exit.
event_contract.missing_data: Missing publication, completion, identity, eligibility, or capacity skips the event with no delayed catch-up trade.
event_contract.corrections: Original, corrected, superseded, and amended documents retain explicit lineage; ambiguous versions exclude the event.
event_contract.duplicate_policy: Identical document/event fingerprints are counted once; distinct securities or legitimately distinct distributions remain distinct.
event_contract.timezone_policy: Store source timezone and convert to UTC with explicit America/New_York DST rules; never truncate timestamps to dates for availability.

instrument_contract.security_identity: Historical security identifier, issuer identity, listing interval, exchange, and share-class continuity are required at every entry/exit.
instrument_contract.eligibility: Historical ETF eligibility and tradability must be proved at the next-open decision boundary; current issuer identity is not historical proof.
instrument_contract.price_basis: A single reconciled split/share basis for signal-independent outcome accounting, with cash distributions and terminal treatment separately recorded.
instrument_contract.missing_identity_policy: Unknown identity, action basis, timestamp, or tradability excludes the affected observation and increments a coverage counter.

data_contract.missing_data: Missing, stale, revised-without-vintage, non-finite, identity-unbound, or unavailable fields exclude rows; no OHLCV or current-label proxy may replace a causal event field.

holdout.required_storage: independent immutable or WORM custody with encrypted raw data and append-only access log

execution_contract.capacity_failure: exclude the candidate exposure and record the suppression reason; never invent a slot or synthetic fill

cost_contract.unfilled_exit: remain in ledger and be reported; no hindsight last-close fill

controls.timing_placebo: same event instruction delayed by 10 regular sessions using only information available at the delayed decision
controls.null_selection: deterministic outcome-independent selection frozen before holdout release

statistics.sample_unit: event episode cluster, not independent daily marks
statistics.prohibition: Do not invent or relax calendar-day, active-day, episode, effect-size, power, or block-length gates after coverage or outcomes are observed.

multiplicity.outcome_seen_variant_policy: All outcome-seen hypotheses and variants that informed R46 selection must be enumerated before alpha is assigned; 45 attempts is not presumed to be the final family size.

allowed_pre_run_tests: base-commit, clean-tree, transitive source-hash, environment, and command checks
source document metadata, identity, duplicate, correction, available_at, and coverage checks
TLT identity, tradability, corporate-action, and next-open calendar checks
aggregate event-frequency and residual-capacity counts without returns or NAV
synthetic native-ledger and fail-closed fixture checks
holdout seal, signature, access-log, release, and one-use checks
forbidden_pre_run_outputs: candidate returns, NAV, P&L, fills, turnover, drawdown, CVaR, Sharpe, or p-values
historical event-date ranking or threshold/variant tuning

stop_policy.promotion_rule: Neither PASS nor acceptance authorizes PAPER, LIVE, registry, production, or automatic promotion.

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false; omit integrity.manifest_sha256 before hashing
